featureWeights.description: Captures the midnight-to-noon nocturnal accumulation and midday sea breeze cleansing.
Tracks the asymmetric rate of evening rush hour buildup vs morning dissipation.
Shapes the two daily traffic concentration peaks (08:00-10:00 and 19:00-22:00 IST).
Day-to-day persistent airmass offset calibrated from morning OpenAQ observations.

physicalMechanisms.impact: Drops PM2.5 sharply by 30-45% between 12:00 and 16:00 IST as clean marine air displaces urban aerosols.
Shallow radiation inversion locks fine particulates below 150m, causing severe spikes from 21:00 to 03:00 IST.

physicalMechanisms.phenomenon: Sanjay Gandhi National Park Biogenic Buffer
physicalMechanisms.impact: Vegetative canopy buffers background aerosol spikes, maintaining smoother day-to-day diurnal variance.

scientificLimitations: Unforeseen point emissions (e.g., temporary construction dust or localized fires) cannot be anticipated without real-time satellite lidar.
Monsoon-to-winter transitional wind reversals cause occasional multi-hour phase shifts in sea-breeze penetration.
Midnight station purging calibration between 23:00 and 02:00 IST limits nighttime sensor availability.
